svg.title: The average conceals different national experiences
svg.desc: Nine small multiples show exports, imports and their ratio, indexed to 100 in the month before each devaluation. Every panel uses the same scale, from 40 to 205. The complete events are Austria, Great Britain and Denmark in September 1931; Norway, Sweden and Finland in October 1931; Estonia in June 1933; Czechoslovakia in February 1934; and Belgium in April 1935. Trade-ratio changes at month twelve are positive in six episodes and negative in Austria, Finland and Belgium. Later 1936 episodes lack complete twelve-month windows.

g.text: Nine complete devaluation windows · nominal trade values and their ratio · identical scales in every panel

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #53636a

g.text: The 1936 episodes lack a full twelve-month window and are excluded. These paths are descriptive, not causal estimates.
